# BCA (Ben Cullen Athletics)

> BCA is a coach-led athletic development company for young athletes, based in Cobham, Surrey, UK. Speed, agility, strength, injury resilience and growth-aware training for ages 6-18, with adult and pro-pathway athletes coached 1:1. In person across Cobham, Elmbridge and Surrey, online worldwide, and delivered through the BCA app. Tagline: "Your complete athletic partner."

## The BCA method
Assess, Develop, Train, Measure, Progress. Every athlete has a BCA Screening, a personal programme approved by a BCA coach, coached sessions in person or online, home sessions in the BCA app, and a retest every 6 weeks. Training adapts to growth spurts, matches, soreness and each new result.

## Who runs it
Ben Cullen, founder: speed and agility specialist and Senior Performance Coach with 18 years of international coaching experience and 30 years in sport. Senior Performance Coach at Ewell Castle Tennis Academy and Surrey U18s Boys Head Coach. The BCA team includes strength and conditioning coach Cherrise Cleary Dowling. All coaches hold enhanced DBS checks, safeguarding training, first aid and insurance.

## Services
- Intro Sessions: two 45-minute in-person sessions with a BCA Screening and a takeaway plan (£90).
- Athletic Fundamentals memberships: weekly in-person coaching. Squad from £89 a month, 1:1 from £120 a month, with the BCA app and testing every 6 weeks.
- The BCA Blueprint: a 3-month in-person system, 24 sessions, nutrition guidance and full testing (£1,497).
- BCA Online Performance: a 3-month individual online programme with screening, weekly coaching and retest, worldwide (£297).
- Schools, academies and clubs: testing days and 6- or 12-week athletic development blocks, in person or online. Clients include Ewell Castle Tennis Academy and Cobham Rugby Club.
- US college pathway: in partnership with Sport USA.

## The BCA app
Athlete profile, starting programme confirmed by a BCA coach, today's session with a video for every drill, a week planner around training and matches, growth tracking, BCA Screening results, messages with the coach, notifications, Kid mode for under-13s, and BCA Scan (movement technique and first-step reaction, measured on the phone; video never leaves the phone).

## Sports
Tennis (a core sport), football, rugby, cricket, hockey, netball, athletics, basketball, dance and more.

## Areas
Cobham, Esher, Oxshott, Weybridge, Walton-on-Thames, Ewell, Elmbridge and Surrey (UK). Online worldwide.
